summary: Frontend-only verification of the two new features on the preview URL. Logged in as usvopp@yahoo.com (login-email/login-password/login-submit). PROGRESS NOTES editor: opened New Note -> selected Test Patient via ManagedSelect option (nf-patient -> nf-patient-opt-6fa0fdd7-8ecf-4619-bb59-03265cbe7834). Suggestions row (icd-suggestions) rendered with chip icd-chip-7eth, its X (icd-chip-remove-7eth), and 'Manage / fix codes' (icd-manage-btn). Clicking icd-manage-btn opened the 'Manage saved ICD-10 codes' modal (icd-manage-list) with a row for 7eth exposing icd-replace-input-7eth, icd-replace-btn-7eth, and icd-bulk-remove-7eth. REPLACE FLOW: entered 'F32.9' in icd-replace-input-7eth and clicked icd-replace-btn-7eth -> toast 'Updated 4 record(s)' appeared, suggestions list refreshed: icd-chip-F32.9 present, icd-chip-7eth gone; the manage row updated from '7eth' to 'F32.9'. RESTORE (test data cleanup): entered '7eth' in icd-replace-input-F32.9 and clicked icd-replace-btn-F32.9 -> toast 'Updated 4 record(s)'; icd-chip-7eth back visible, icd-chip-F32.9 gone. DISMISS CHIP (non-destructive): closed manage modal, clicked icd-chip-remove-7eth -> toast 'Code removed from suggestions', chip hid from suggestions row, manage modal did NOT open (non-destructive dismiss confirmed). Cleaned up via POST /api/notes/patient-code-history/restore (200); after reselecting the patient, chip 7eth reappeared -- state restored. CLAIMS PAGE: navigated to /claims, list rendered with claim-open-<id> testids, opened claim 033cdb5e-6db6-407c-8e81-be29456b99f6 (packet 'Test Patient 07/15/2026 FMP Claim', shown as 9 items in the detail header). Clicked claim-download-merged -> download was triggered and completed with a 349,430-byte PDF named 'Test_Patient_07_15_2026_FMP_Claim.pdf'. Since this packet has 9 items (>8), the frontend routed through the ASYNC path (POST /claims/{cid}/merged/async -> pollJob -> jobs/{jid}/download); the download succeeded which exercises the background-job packet-build flow end-to-end. Button label swap ('Generating packet' with spinner while packetBuilding=true) was not visually captured due to the fast job (small file), but the pollJob code path completed without errors and the button was re-enabled/download delivered.
critical_code_review_comments: Notes.js dismissIcd() catch block silently toasts 'Failed' with no message — consider surfacing apiErr(err) so operators can distinguish 401/403 from a real backend failure.

Claims.js downloadMerged() polls up to 150 * 2s = 5min (pollJob loop). For packets that hit the 15MB / 8-doc threshold this is generous, but there is no user-visible cancel affordance while packetBuilding=true — the button is only disabled. Consider adding a cancel/abort action tied to the job id.

Notes.js bulkFix() only shows total updated as (notes_updated + invoices_updated); the backend returns them separately — surfacing e.g. 'Updated 2 notes and 2 invoices' would be more transparent when auditing bulk edits.
seed_data_creation: None. Test Patient ICD-10 '7eth' was temporarily replaced with 'F32.9' then restored back to '7eth' (round-trip; two Updated 4 record(s) toasts). Dismissed suggestion was restored via POST /api/notes/patient-code-history/restore (200). No residual test data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Testids in use: login-email, login-password, login-submit, add-note-btn, nf-patient (ManagedSelect button; options exposed as nf-patient-opt-<uuid>), icd-suggestions, icd-chip-<code>, icd-chip-remove-<code>, icd-manage-btn, icd-manage-list, icd-replace-input-<code>, icd-replace-btn-<code>, icd-bulk-remove-<code>, claim-open-<id>, claim-download-merged. Note: nf-patient is a custom ManagedSelect (button + portal panel), NOT a native <select> — playwright select_option() will fail; click the button and then click nf-patient-opt-<id>. Existing packet 033cdb5e-6db6-407c-8e81-be29456b99f6 is currently 9 items so it hits the async merged-PDF path — good regression fixture for the background packet build. Test Patient still has ICD '7eth' saved on the second note (state restored).
rca_of_the_issue: N/A — no defects found. Both new features (ICD-10 bulk cleanup manage modal + non-destructive chip dismiss, and background packet build on Merge & Save PDF) work end-to-end on preview.
